name: app-purple-light-tracker-widget-with-uv-gauge
title: Violet daylight app with a yellow progress bar, UV gradient and translucent tiles
whatItIs: A saturated violet phone screen with a translucent 'Go outside now' pill and avatar, a two-line bold prompt, a yellow-filled bar showing 53%, and two frosted tiles with a UV index rainbow bar and a lux reading, above a weather row.
whatItMeans: Bright and encouraging; violet with yellow bar suggests sunlight indoors.
techniques: Use translucent tiles on a saturated field.
Fill a bar with yellow to signal sunlight.
Set headlines bold and readings in monospace.
Show a rainbow scale for UV.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent tile over a colour field.
A colour gradient bar for UV levels.
A number set in monospace type.
A bold instruction at the top.
